reviews.text:
I heard a rumor so had to check it out...Really a 13" Mozz stick LOL cmon VERIFIED...Actually 14" and about 2" wide. It was actually pretty good. Not my favorite breading but better than many I've had. I prefer the seasoned tasty breading.

They also have 1 lb pizza slices...I measured it at 8" wide and long...with thickness yea it's probably close to 1 lb. It was pretty good but not great. The crust is a little to strong flour tasting for my taste. I'd like to see a garlic or something. It was cooked perfect though just slightly crispy on outside but soft inside. I'm kinda picky on crust. Price was very reasonable

I also tried the Monthly special burger Brisket and bacon a really good sauce etc

The prices seemed very reasonable. I'll definitely be back

reviews.text:
This spot is a hidden gem for comfort food lovers! The first thing that caught my attention? Their giant mozzarella stick — no exaggeration, it’s HUGE! Perfectly crispy on the outside and unbelievably cheesy on the inside (we had to do the cheese pull, of course 😍).

We tried a little bit of everything — the mac & cheese burger (creamy, cheesy, and messy in the best way), the gyro pizza that hit the perfect flavor combo, and their wings that came out hot, crispy, and full of flavor. Every bite was indulgent and totally worth the cheat day!

To top it off, their milkshake was thick, rich, and topped with whipped cream — the perfect dessert drink.
The vibe inside is super chill with a retro feel, checkerboard floors, and even a checkerboard table game to play while you wait.

If you’re looking for comfort food done right — creative, hearty, and fun — Frato’s is definitely the move. 🍔🍕🧀💯

reviews.text: First time here, honestly my family and I thought it was really good. Our food did take some time to be done but then again it’s made fresh, you can tell and when we tasted our food we understood the wait haha. The portion is insane worth every penny. Unlimited drink refills. Napkins on every table because trust me you will need them.  And the vibe is very chill. Music was good. And they had tvs with different things going on. From trivia games to funny videos, Trust me you will be entertained and well feed. Also they had slot machines for any adults who felt like they could get lucky after eating a delicious burger. The guy at the register was so nice his name was Jadon I believe. Made the whole ordering process so much more easier. Very nice guy! And the rest of the staff very friendly. We will definitely be coming back.

Super delicious and amazing food!  The staff is caring and courteous. The creativity of the food is wonderful. We live about 35 min away and heard of Frato’s Culinary Kitchen and its hype so we thought about trying it. Definitely worth it and have been there a few times now trying different things every time and will be doing it again!!  I found it’s great for us when ordering on line ahead of time. We provide a ready time of when we’ll be arriving. The appetizer is ready in half the time and all other food shortly after that so there is no long waiting on empty stomachs.  We can eat delicious hot food right away while enjoying our time there!

PS..below didn’t mention their custom pizzas as an option and worth mentioning that they are amazing!!

reviews.text:
Hands down one of the BEST pizza spots around! The crust is perfectly crispy, the cheese is gooey, and the toppings are always fresh and loaded with flavor and to top it off their pizza sauce is homemade. Every bite is just chef’s kiss. If you’re a pizza lover, this place will instantly become your new go-to. Not only do they have pizza, but they have amazing burgers, shakes, apps, and much more.

On top of the amazing food, the service is unbeatable. Alex was beyond awesome—super friendly, quick, and made us feel right at home. Prices are affordable, which is crazy considering how high-quality everything tastes.

And here’s the kicker—they’ve got awesome games to play while you wait, so the fun never stops (though the pizza comes out so fast, you barely have to wait!). Between the tasty pizza, the great vibes, and Alex’s top-notch service, this spot is a total winner. Highly recommend! 🍕🔥

reviews.text:
We have been searching for a good Gyros near us.
THIS IS IT!!!
Forget Brandys. Overpriced and average.
Forget Little Greek. Used to be ok. It’s not even run by Greeks anymore
Qp is good for their chicken, but the gyros is meh.

FRATOS meat was cooked on the grill after being shaved for just a minute, adding to the texture and flavor.
And it was PLENTIFUL!
Pita was also grilled just long enough to make it warm and not taste doughy.
Tzatziki was flavorful and fresh but not too garlicky or cucumbery. Perfect balance.

Last minute I ordered the mac and cheese.
Ooey-gooey delicious! When I came home I added a little diced jalapeño.
AMAZING.

We have FINALLY found our new gyros go to!

reviews.text:
9/2021 Tried it again.  5 stars.  Pizza is really good.  Staff is good too.  I am not as big a fan of the Buffalo Mozzarella cheese on the pizza.  I would prefer it without it.  But in general it is all good.

7/2021  Gave it 3 stars.  Could be a 3.5 maybe.  First time here.  I had troubles ordering the Thursday special for BOGO Chicken tenders online.  So they took care of me over the phone.  Thank you!  Great service.  The staff was great on the phone and super friendly and nice in person.  They were a joy to meet.

Food was not as good though as I expected.  Got a slice of 1# pizza.  WOW.  It really was a full pound I think.  Looks amazing!  In general I loved it.  For my personal taste though, it tasted like it had parmesan cheese on it.  I am not a fan of parmesan.  It all tasted good though, and I would recommend it to other.  For me, no parm would be better though.

I also got the BOGO Sweet BBQ Chicken tenders.  I should have stuck to the Buttermilk tenders.  Wish I had tried those maybe.  The pictures show how yummy they look.  They look amazing!  I did not care for the taste.  So much so that I actually did not eat the second ones.  It took me two days to eat the first order.  And I could not stomach the thought of the second batch, so I threw them out.  Glad they were free!  Chicken was good, but I did not like the outside.  If I ever get back there, I may try the regular ones instead.
